settings.title: Place your design
settings.description: Position your design on the garment

settings.title: Cover with sheet
settings.description: Lay the PTFE cover sheet over your design

settings.title: Press normally
settings.description: Press at your normal settings (may need 2-3 extra seconds)

settings.question: How many times can I reuse this?
settings.answer: With proper care, our PTFE sheets last hundreds of presses. Wipe clean between uses and store flat.

settings.question: What temperature is it rated for?
settings.answer: Our PTFE sheets are rated up to 500°F (260°C), suitable for all standard heat press applications.

settings.question: Will it work with my heat press?
settings.answer: Yes! Our sheets work with all clamshell, swing-away, and draw-style heat presses from any brand.
